digest.component_or_area: inbound fetcher / projects store / apply inbound records
propositions: The inbound fetcher currently resolves only a single query_project and builds one JQL pair, causing it to ingest issues from only one project even when the store mapping lists multiple projects
Parent, comment, and issuelink enrichment data is silently dropped for all projects except one due to single-project scoping of all three enrichment passes
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset
The solution must fan out JQL queries and enrichment passes per configured project while merging results into a shared snapshot, maintaining per-project truncation ceilings
Source project provenance must be recorded by deriving the project key prefix from the jira_key and stamping bridge_project and repos fields at the CREATE write site
